title: : YOU ARE A MASTERPIECE
body: : YOU ARE A MASTERPIECE “. wonderfully made.” [KJV] Ps 139:14 The quiet but salient reality is that you’re carefully conceived, created and crafted a masterpiece. You’re exclusively formed and fashioned, polished after the similitude of a palace. You’re an excellent-piece, a royal-piece, a first-class piece, a perfect-piece, and above it all, a masterpiece. “For we are God's masterpiece.” [NLT] Eph 2:10. Hmnh! God’s masterpiece; created anew! You’re God’s achievement in Christ! God, who is the ultimate Designer - perfect in all His ways - created you in the best perfect way. See yourself the way God sees you regardless of the way others see you. What others see about you is no issue; what you see about yourself is the real big issue. You’re perfectly created for God's perfect plan. You are put together to fulfill God’s exciting and specific intentions here on earth!
confession: I am God's workmanship, recreated in Christ Jesus, [born anew] to mirror Him. I am an excellent-piece, a royal-piece, a first-class piece, a perfect-piece, and above it all, a MASTERPIECE [Say this repeatedly] [Hymn: Jesus loves even me]. Pray with Special Breakthrough Prayers and spend quality time in the place of prayer.

title: : CALLED TO BE FRUITFUL AND SUCCESSFUL
body: : CALLED TO BE FRUITFUL AND SUCCESSFUL “You didn't choose me! I chose you! I appointed you.” [TLB] John 15:16 Some say, ‘God never called me to be successful. He only called me to be faithful.’ That’s just half truth. He has called us both to be faithful as well as successful. Faithfulness alone is not enough, you’ve to go extra miles in seeing that you are successful in all your undertakings. “You have not chosen Me, but I have chosen you and I have appointed you [I have planted you], that you might go and bear fruit and keep on bearing, and that your fruit may be lasting [that it may remain, abide].” [Amp] John 15:16. Jesus cursed a fig tree because it didn’t bear fruit, Matt 21:19. That’s how important fruitfulness is. Faithfulness is only half the equation. Here is TBCL, “You didn't choose me, remember; I chose you, and put you in the world to bear fruit, fruit that won't spoil.”
confession: I am a fruitful being. Everything I do prospers. He appointed me for success. I am not a failure. Underneath my feet is the everlasting arm. He is my Aid, my Fortress, my Guide and my All in All - in whom I trust. Because He lives, I can do all things through Christ who is constantly strengthening me.

title: : PREP ARING FOR GREA TNESS
verse: in the field; and after that, see to the building.”
body: : PREP ARING FOR GREA TNESS “Put your work in order outside, and make it ready in the field; and after that, see to the building.” (BBE) Pro 24:27 No magic formula for reaching the top. No hit and run formula for greatness. You don’t rise to greatness; you work to greatness. “But by the grace (the unmerited favor and blessing) of God I am what I am, and His grace toward me was not [found to be] for nothing (fruitless and without effect). In fact, I worked harder than all of them [the apostles], though it was not really I, but the grace (the unmerited favor and blessing) of God which was with me” (Amp) 1 Cor 15:10. Working harder than all - is one of the keys - to greatness. Greatness starts with YOU. You’re the only person who can give yourself permission for greatness. You have to sit on yourself to achieve God’s dreams for your life. But then, preparation is vital if you must succeed, Luke 14:28. Preparation precedes prospects - don’t ever forget!
confession: Inside of me is the seed of greatness. I have what it takes to succeed in life. I pull down whatever is holding me back in achieving God’s plans [ Hymn: Trust and Obey]. Pray with Special Breakthrough Prayers. “. Passion. consume[s] me” (KJV) John 2:17 Without passion, purpose is wingless. Every act of greatness is rooted in every act of passion. Passion is the beginning, the continuity and the sustenance of greatness. You always need passion if you must make progress. Get something worth living for and get passionate about it. The road to greatness is not always easy to navigate - It’s rough and hilly; but with hard work, tireless pursuit and intense passion that touches the heart, you can scale through to your desired height. Paul wrote in Col 3:23, “Work hard and cheerfully at all you do, just as though you were working for the Lord and not merely for your masters” (TLB). “Whatever may be your task, work at it heartily (from the soul), as [something done] for the Lord and not for men” (Amp). Working heartily - that is passion in simple term! That’s what it takes to succeed. Go passionate and you’ll go possessing! Never sacrifice your passion on the altar of complexity.

title: : YOU ALWAYS NEED P ASSION
body: : YOU ALWAYS NEED P ASSION

title: : GREA TNESS AND GOODNESS
verse: does not do it, to him it is sin” (NASB) James 4:17
body: : GREA TNESS AND GOODNESS “. to one who knows the right thing to do, and does not do it, to him it is sin” (NASB) James 4:17 The beauty of life is in the act of goodness. Real, true greatness is in real, true goodness. “. whoever has this world's goods, and sees his brother in need, and shuts up his heart from him, how does the love of God abide in him. let us not love in word, neither in tongue; but in deed and in truth” (NKJV) 1 John 3:17-18. The Amplified says, “. let us not love [merely] in theory or in speech but in deed and in truth (in practice and in sincerity).” If you want your daily life to look great and glorious, learn to demonstrate real, true goodness to everyone God strategically brings your way, Act 10:38. Go for the act of goodness. Be kind! Be lovely! Be friendly! Be hospitable! Goodness and greatness are like two faces of the coin. They are inseparable!
confession: Inside of me are the noblest seeds of goodness. I tap into Jesus-kind of goodness who went about doing good. I am anointed to do good. I step up higher in the realm of goodness by Your Spirit Divine [Say this repeatedly]. Pray with Special Breakthrough Prayers. “. taking the form of a servant, he humbled himself.” (ASV) Phil 2:5-8 True humility isn’t thinking less of yourself. It’s not being outwardly humble while harboring pride within. And it’s not being weak. True humility is service to others, and service to a cause that brings glory to God. And that’s the secret behind growing from one level of greatness to another. Pro 22:4 says, “By humility and the fear of the LORD are riches, and honour, and life” (KJV). There is honour in humility. With greater humility you enjoy greater honour. If you will not stumble, you must be humble. “In your life together, think the way Christ Jesus thought. Instead, he gave up everything, even his place with God. He accepted the role of a servant, appearing in human form. During his life as a man, he humbled himself by being fully obedient to God, even when that caused his death - death on a cross” (ERV). Humility signifies the taking on the form and figure of a servant to serve rather than been served. It’s about possessing the mind of Christ.

title: : HUMILITY: THE W AY TO GREA TNESS
body: : HUMILITY: THE W AY TO GREA TNESS

title: : YOU’VE GOT TO GROW YOUR F AITH
body: : YOU’VE GOT TO GROW YOUR F AITH “. If ye have faith. nothing shall be impossible unto you” (KJV) Matt 17:20 You're always down because you’re always doubting. When a man's heart is full of doubt, the atmosphere around his destiny will look cloudy and clumsy. No man rises to greatness beyond his level of faith. It is faith that leads to fame and lofty future. If you must be great then you've got to grow your faith. “. taking the shield of faith.” (KJV). Eph 6:16. So, study the Word of God daily. Listen to faith-inspiring messages. Pray in the Holy Ghost. As you grow your faith, your faith in turn will cause your future to glow. You must work on your faith-life, Romans 10:17. Every glorious future is a function of great faith. Your today's glorious or empty life is a function of your yesterday's great faith or fear. If you desire a fruitful and flourishing future, faith is the factor as well as the foundation. No other way! If you want to be great in life, career and ministry, change your words and your words will change your world.
prayer: 1. Come against every spirit of doubt 2. Ask God to increase your faith 3. Talk to your spiritman to begin to operate in a higher dimension of faith, from today 4. Intercede for Nations. “. greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world” (KJV) 1 John 4:4 You’re of God, from God and for God. When a man gives his life to Jesus, the Holy Spirit comes to dwell - inhabit, resident - inside of him. By God’s special design, he has come under the direct influence of the Holy Spirit. No longer the old but the new man. “Hereby know we that we dwell in him, and he in us, because he hath given us of his Spirit” (KJV) 1 John 4:13. He dwells in you and you dwell in Him - You’re of a nobler descent, of a more excellent pedigree, of a heavenly parentage, of a higher lineage and of a superior offspring. Your origin is divine! You’re more powerful by the virtue of the Holy Spirit in you. “. He Who lives in you is greater (mightier) than he who is in the world” (Amp). That’s it! You’re greater and mightier! Never be intimidated! The devil is no match to you. By saying what the Word says, you enjoy numerous possibilities of the Word.

title: : THE DEVIL IS NO MA TCH TO YOU!
body: : THE DEVIL IS NO MA TCH TO YOU! “And Joseph's master took him, and put him into the prison.” (KJV) Gen 39:20 “Do not be conformed to this age, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may discern what is the good, pleasing, and perfect will of God” (HCSB) Rom 12:2. When Joseph's master put him in prison, it was as if an end had come to his dream. Joseph never considered himself a misfit though he went from the pit to the dungeon where he received cruel treatment. No man, no, not even the devil is strong enough to get God's purpose for your life imprisoned. You’re the only one who can imprison that purpose. There is something amazing about the life of this young man, he was busy helping others even when himself needed help. Joseph was forgotten by men, but he was never forgotten by God. If Joseph could not die right in the prison, it is certain and evident that you will not die in your condition, you will surely rise, reign and rejoice. Keep renewing your mind by His Word.
prayer: 1. Talk to God that His plans of success shall come true in your life and nothing shall abort it 2. Ask God for grace to always renew your mind by His Word 3. Commit your day into His hand.

title: : RENEWING YOUR MIND
verse: henceforth we should not serve sin” (KJV) Rom 6:6
body: : RENEWING YOUR MIND “Knowing this, that our old man is crucified with him, that the body of sin might be destroyed, that henceforth we should not serve sin” (KJV) Rom 6:6 Self limits. You either conquer self or self will conquer you. The very first thing every child of God must fight against is self and not Satan. By the time you've conquered self, you're on your way to your desired greatness. Paul wrote in Gal 2: 20, “I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me.” (KJV). That old man must be crucified. Self must die! Be it self-centeredness, self-righteousness, selfishness, or self-destructive thought. If you must be a king, loose the grip of self over your life and see yourself reign and rule. You’ll not be found qualified in the sight of God to conquer the world until self in all its ramification is conquered in you, Eph 4:22. Ask God to cleanse you of all manifestations of self and promise Him to live for Christ and His glory. Give yourself to constant meditation on God's Word and learn to keep a praying and watchful spirit. You can conquer self that limits greatness.
prayer: 1. Renounce and reject everything called self in your life. 2. Ask God for grace to always live above self 3. Redeem your day by His blood.

title: : SELF THAT LIMITS GREA TNESS
body: : SELF THAT LIMITS GREA TNESS

title: 1: PROCLAIMING HIS GREA TNESS 1
body: 1: PROCLAIMING HIS GREA TNESS 1 “And Jesus went about all the cities and villages.” (KJV) Matt 9:35 It’s remarkable the way NASB puts our text, “And Jesus was going about all the cities and the villages, teaching in their synagogues, and proclaiming the gospel of the kingdom.” You’re called to go and preach the gospel. You are to take the Word to the World! You’re to go everywhere, wherever, men are found and announce the good news. “Go and proclaim these words toward the north, and say, Return, thou backsliding Israel, saith the LORD.” [KJV] Jer 3:12. Proclaim His Word and lead backsliders back home. For this is your sole responsibility! Go with the consciousness of His anointing upon your life both to heal and set free. The disciples were not baptized in the Holy Spirit when they were sent out by Jesus to preach, still, the devils were subject unto them through the name of Jesus, Matt 10:1. You are no ordinary man. You’ve the power over unclean spirits and demons of infirmities!
confession: I commit myself to proclaiming Jesus. I will preach Jesus - always doing the work of an evangelist. I will never again loose the focus of this heaven ordained assignment. “For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ: for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth.” (KJV) Rom 1:16 “I have complete confidence in the gospel; it is God's power to save all who believe.” [GNT]. The gospel is the only power to effect transformation. As Christians, preaching of the gospel must be our passionate pursuit. World-wide evangelism must be our focus. All our resources must be channeled to this eternal course. All hands must be on deck to see the world saved. You must be a gospel preacher! The work of the gospel is every believer's ministry. Every believer is an evangelist. Promoting His glory and propagating His gospel is the sole ministry of every child of God. Salvation brings a man to a world of grave responsibility. We must all, without exception, preach the W-O-R-D! C. S. Lewis says, “The Church exists for nothing else but to draw men into Christ, to make them little Christs. God became Man for no other purpose.”

title: : PROCLAIMING HIS GREA TNESS 2
body: : PROCLAIMING HIS GREA TNESS 2

title: : PRA YING YOURSELF TO GREA TNESS
verse: thee go, except thou bless me” (KJV) Gen 32:26
body: : PRA YING YOURSELF TO GREA TNESS “. Let me go, for the day breaketh. I will not let thee go, except thou bless me” (KJV) Gen 32:26 For a higher dimension of progress you need a higher dimension of prayer! Prayer precedes progress. Prayer is both the key and the lock, Jam 5:16. You can't experience all round breakthrough without all round prayer. If you must grow great, you must learn the act of praying through to breakthrough. You must pray until something happens (PUSH). Gates don't open on their own accord; I believe you know, you've got to push to pass through. Doors of divine blessings and breakthrough don't open on their own accord; they only open in response to your PUSH. The power and potency of prayer cannot be underestimated. Prayer controls the hand that controls the universe. Prayer can do what God can do. Prayer is intercontinental. No geographical barrier or barricade. A prayer of faith can be uttered in Nigeria and take effect in Netherlands. Praying in the will of God guarantees answer, John 5:14.
prayer: 1. Thank Him for the power of prevailing prayer 2. Ask God for the outpouring of the spirit of prayer. Pray with Special Breakthrough Prayers. “And it came to pass about the time of shutting of the gate, when it was dark, that the men went out: whither the men went I wot not: pursue after them quickly; for ye shall overtake them” (KJV) Jos 2:5 Phil 3: 13-14 says, “No, dear brothers, I am still not all I should be, but I am bringing all my energies to bear on this one thing: Forgetting the past and looking forward to what lies ahead, I strain to reach the end of the race and receive the prize.” [TLB]. Bringing all energies to bear - that’s pursuit - straining to reach the prize. Real life begins with real pursuit. What you don't pursue, you don't possess. You've got to be a pursuer to be a possessor. Greatness, certainly, is making a significant difference in a way that distinguishes you from your equals. In pursuit of greatness, you always need a clear sense of direction plus passion to match. Without pursuit, purpose is defeated. If you must fulfil God's eternal purpose for your life, you must passionately ride on the wings of pursuit. Be passionate about your dreams.

title: : THE PURSUIT OF GREA TNESS
body: : THE PURSUIT OF GREA TNESS

title: : GOING FOR GREA T GOAL
verse: made conformable unto his death” (KJV) Phil 3:10
body: : GOING FOR GREA T GOAL “That I may know him, and the power of his resurrection. the fellowship of his sufferings, being made conformable unto his death” (KJV) Phil 3:10 Paul's singular goal was Christ and His resurrection power. And that must be your goal too - to have an all-encompassing experience of His person. When you draw closer to Jesus, He draws closer to you. Be so familiar with the person of Jesus to the point where His voice is unmistakable. You always need His voice to be a voice. Create time for daily communion with Christ. Make Him your very best friend. Let His fullness be your daily goal and aspiration. “I gave up all that inferior stuff so I could know Christ personally, experience his resurrection power, be a partner in his suffering, and go all the way with him to death itself” (TBCL). Give up that inferior stuff! “Now I have given up everything else - I have found it to be the only way to really know Christ and to experience the mighty power that brought him back to life again, and to find out what it means to suffer and to die with him” (TLB).
prayer: 1. Ask for grace to know Him more 2. Ask for grace to walk with Him better. 3. Promise to live by His Word, remain in His Will and walk in His Way. “Know ye not that they which run in a race run all. So run, that ye may obtain” (KJV) 1 Cor 9:24 Theodore Roosevelt said, “Far better it is to dare mighty things, to win glorious triumphs, even though checkered by failure, than to take rank with those poor spirits who neither enjoy much nor suffer much, because they live in the gray twilight that knows not victory nor defeat.” Becoming great is like running in a race, you must give it what it takes to be a winner. Helen Keller said, “I long to accomplish a great and noble task, but it is my chief duty to accomplish small tasks as if they were great and noble.” “You may be disappointed if you fail, but you are doomed if you don't try.” “Sometimes our best is simply not enough. We have to do what is required.” If you'll not allow challenges to limit you; you'll become a wonder to behold. Martins Luther King Jr. must be right, “The ultimate measure of a man is not where he stands in moments of comfort and convenience, but where he stands at times of challenges and controversy.”

title: : YOU MUST REACH FOR TH TO REACH THERE
body: : YOU MUST REACH FOR TH TO REACH THERE

title: : W AITING FOR HIS GREA T COMING
body: : W AITING FOR HIS GREA T COMING “Watch ye therefore: for ye know not when the master of the house cometh, at even, or at midnight, or at the cockcrowing, or in the morning” (KJV) Mark 13:35 Matt 24:42, 44 says, “Watch therefore: for ye know not what hour your Lord doth come. Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh” [KJV]. This was Christ’s passionate message to His dear disciples. The need for continuous waiting and constant watching cannot be overemphasized. We all must wait for His glorious coming patiently - without soiling our garment in the midst of prevailing iniquities, John 14:2-3. While waiting and watching, avoid willful sin. Be an instrument of transformation - reach out to everyone in your circle of influence with the pure Word of God. Keep all you do within the orbit of the influence of the Holy Spirit - and never grieve Him! 1 Pet 4:7-8.
confession: Until I reach my home, I will never stop my journey halfway. I will never give up on my most precious faith. I will never, ever give up on God and serving Him. My mind is made up to hold on till He comes to take me home. I must make it and I will surely make it by His limitless grace. “Mark the perfect man, and behold the upright: for the end of that man is peace” (KJV) Ps 37:37 Marie Curie (1867 – 1934) was an ordinary being with an extraordinary spirit. She was a chemist and physicist. After the husband's death, she concentrated all her energies on research and caring for her daughters and by 1906, She became a professor of general physics. As we learn from her, be a person of influence and excellent virtue. Be attractive within and without. Be a person of credible character. Be an asset everywhere you go. As a father, mother, student, business individual, CEO, pastor, work towards great achievement in your own field of choice. Let your daily activities be marked with excellence. Your spiritual, social, physical, business and academic life must daily be in hot pursuit of excellence. Be different. Be goal-oriented. Be committed! You’re not called to be Marie Curie. But you’re called to touch lives. Be committed to enduring works that will still be speaking hundreds of years after you might have gone.

title: : MARK THIS GREA T WOMAN
body: : MARK THIS GREA T WOMAN

title: : MARK THIS GREA T MAN
verse: the end of that man is peace” (KJV) Psalms 37:37
body: : MARK THIS GREA T MAN “Mark the perfect man, and behold the upright: for the end of that man is peace” (KJV) Psalms 37:37 I'm bringing the man William Carey to your door step today. He was a missionary to Indian, linguist and agriculturist. How he fulfilled God's Word in Rom 12:11, “Not slothful in business; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord.” Idleness is no gain. If you must be great, you must be a worker and not just a talker. Carey's motto was, “Expect great things from God. Attempt great things for God.” Carey got converted at 18 and directed his intellect to mastering Latin, Greek, Hebrew, Italian and Dutch with the focus of reaching the world for Christ. We’re saved to serve. With the help of others, Carey founded 26 churches and 126 schools, translated Scripture into 44 languages, organized India's first medical mission. He was instrumental in founding the Agricultural and Horticultural Society of Indian in 1820. Many other works were his great exploits. Carey is no more today. But you’re still alive. What will you do to make your life count? Do bear in mind, “Footprints on the sands of time are not made by sitting down.”
prayer: 1. Promise to live for Him 2. Surrender it all - your entire life - for His glory. [Hymn: I Surrender All] “Mark the perfect man, and behold the upright: for the end of that man is peace” (KJV) Psa 37:37 Sir Edmund Hillary (1919-2008) was an ordinary man with an extra-ordinary mind for great exploits as a mountain climber and Antarctic explorer. The key to exploits is in that extra commitment to your noble vision and that's what makes the difference between successful and unsuccessful people. Hillary was one of the first two men to reach the summit of Mount Everest (29, 035 feet). This he did with his counterpart Sherpa on May 29, 1953. Hillary obtained his early mountaineering experience in the Southern Alps of New Zealand. That is it! Knowledge is the key. Relate with men that matter around you. Newly crowned British monarch Elizabeth II knighted Hillary for his noble achievement. If Hillary could achieve extraordinary feat, you can achieve it too and even more. Know what you want and go for it. With the power of concentration, you're unstoppable. Arise, greater is he that is in you than he that was in Hillary. I say, go and succeed.

title: : MARK THIS GREA T MAN
body: : MARK THIS GREA T MAN

title: : THAT GREA T CITY
verse: the city was pure gold, like unto clear glass” (KJV)
body: : THAT GREA T CITY “And the building of the wall of it was of jasper: and the city was pure gold, like unto clear glass” (KJV) Rev 21:18 The magnificence and brilliance of the heavenly city exceeds human description and earthly explanation - It’s flawless and beautiful beyond conception, Rev 21:19. It’s the City whose foundation is garnished with every precious gem imaginable. It’s the City whose builder is God! It’s such a city where we shall behold Jesus’ blazing and glorious face. A city of no darkness! Rev 21:23 says, “And the city had no need of the sun, neither of the moon, to shine in it: for the glory of God did lighten it, and the Lamb is the light thereof.” The indwelling presence of the Lamb gives light in it supernaturally. As gold surpasses all metals and is not subject to corruption and as precious stones are full of radiance and brilliance, in the same way will the heavenly mansions be most glorious and dazzling exceptional, Rev 21: 21-26; Luke 13:24.
prayer: Dear Lord Jesus, thank You for the many mansions in Your Father’s house. Thank You for preparing a place for me. I pray never to loose the sight of eternity in Jesus precious name, Amen. [Hymn: When the Roll is Called up Yonder] “The LORD by wisdom hath founded the earth.” (KJV) Pro 3:19-20 The great become great in proportion to their ruling thoughts and so, the failure become failure in proportion to their ruling thoughts. Your thoughts will either lead you to bondage or freedom. It is man's thoughts that eminently recreate man's destiny. Many great destinies are ruined because of negative thoughts. If your life, health, home and destiny will not end up a failure, you must fully arm yourself with the Word of life. There is power - redemptive power, healing power, life-giving power and destiny-sharpening power - in the Word. Success in life is in God's Word. Read it daily, meditate on it always, be filled with the Word and let it control your thoughts. No one can be truly great without knowing the Word. The Bible is simply the book of bliss. By the time you allow the Bible to govern your life, everything around you becomes blissful.

title: : WHY MEN ARE NOT GREA T
body: : WHY MEN ARE NOT GREA T

title: : W AR AGAINST THE FORCES THAT LIMIT
verse: the violent take it by force” (KJV) Matt 11:12
body: : W AR AGAINST THE FORCES THAT LIMIT “. the kingdom of heaven suffereth violence, and the violent take it by force” (KJV) Matt 11:12 Here is a gallant statement about spiritual warfare, “For though we walk in the flesh, we do not war after the flesh: (For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds.” (KJV) 2 Cor 10:3-5. Wagging and winning war against the forces of darkness is a necessity if excelling beyond the level called average is your desire. The reality of the spiritual forces can not be underestimated, they’re real as well as limiting! It takes advanced warfare prayer and faith-based actions to possess territories and experience kingdom wealth transfer. If you must possess the kingdom, you must understand what it takes to win an invisible battle. Advanced spiritual warfare is a must - forces of darkness must be subdued, demonic forces must be conquered, territorial devils must be defeated, principalities and powers must be overcome - take the battle to the gates of the enemies, Eph 6:11-13.
prayer: 1. Come against every force of darkness militating against your success 2. Destroy all their activities against your life (In hot fervent prayers). “. Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, Oh that thou wouldest bless me indeed, and enlarge my coast. God granted him that which he requested” (KJV) 1 Chro 4:10 It is the understanding of God's purpose for your life that helps you to prioritize your life accordingly. Everything God made was good! When Jabez knew he was born to be great, he decided not to die small - “Jabez cried out to the God of Israel, "Oh, that you would bless me and enlarge my territory! Let your hand be with me, and keep me from harm so that I will be free from pain." And God granted his request” [NIV]. He cried out to God and enjoyed a remarkable degree of prosperity. People can't determine your destiny except you allow it. Circumstances can't determine happenings around you except you agree with it. Even your enemies are not strong enough to alter your life. God's WORD is final over your life. Jabez, the son of sorrow, by prayer of faith inherited joy at the end.

title: : YOU ARE BORN GREA T - DON’T DIE SMALL!
body: : YOU ARE BORN GREA T - DON’T DIE SMALL!

title: : ENEMY OF GREA TNESS
body: : ENEMY OF GREA TNESS “And seek not ye what ye shall eat. neither be ye of doubtful mind” (KJV) Lk 12:29 You can't doubt it and get enough strength to dare it! One of the greatest enemies of greatness is doubt. No man lives in doubt and live to be dignified. Doubt erodes human dignity, weakens the inner strength for every extraordinary move, and drains your confidence in God. “What I'm trying to do here is get you to relax, not be so preoccupied with getting so you can respond to God's giving” (TBCL). Enough of doubt. Doubt damns destiny! You can't keep doubting it and not end up in distress and destitution. Your thought exerts great influence on your life. Stop being a doubter! Doubters are drifters! Matthew 21:21. Let each day be great. God won't make your day great for you. You just have to make it great yourself. Think possibilities!
prayer: Blessed Jesus, having understood the enemy of greatness, I ask for inner enablement to always live by faith and never in doubt. I choose this day never to doubt any long, I put my trust in You. I believe in great possibilities, for this I pray in Jesus precious name, Amen. “Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised; and his greatness is unsearchable” (KJV) Psalms 145:3 God's greatness is beyond investigation and human explanation. Imagine the length, breath, height and depth of God's unsearchable greatness. Consider the creation of the millions of stars. Have a look at the firmament; behold the brightness of the sun - its size and its importance. Consider the good handwork of God in creating the heavens and the earth. Now, consider your own making - God's express image, Psalms 48:1, Psalms 95:3. How often do you praise God? This God is praiseworthy. “For the LORD is great, and greatly to be praised: he is to be feared above all gods” (KJV) Psalms 96:4. One of the proven pathways to prominence is praise. It is praise that paves way for prestige. You can always praise yourself to your greatness. As you walk in the light of the Word each day of your life, the LORD prospers your way and establishes your plans.

title: : BECAUSE GOD IS GREA T
body: : BECAUSE GOD IS GREA T

title: : YOU ARE A CARRIER OF DIVINE CHROMOSOME
verse: because he is born of God” (KJV) 1 John 3:9
body: : YOU ARE A CARRIER OF DIVINE CHROMOSOME “. his seed remaineth in him: and he cannot sin, because he is born of God” (KJV) 1 John 3:9 You’ve God-kind of nature in you! “. for God's nature abides in him [His principle of life, the divine sperm, remains permanently within him].” [Amp]. You’re of divine spermatozoa! That’s the divine deposit to operate in the realm beyond the natural. Inside of you are potentials. For you to be successful in life: 1. You've got to believe the fact that the seed of God for success is in you. Believing precedes becoming - what you don't believe, you don't become. 2. You must lay hold on the promises of God concerning your success. You've got to be a confessor to be a custodian of God's riches. 3. You’ve to think and talk success. You have to think and talk it to take a hold of it. Without thinking it, talking it, you will be far from taking over it. 4. You have to walk with successful people. Your location determines your allocation. Your site determines your settlement. 5. You must be ready to pay the price for success. See you at the top!
prayer: Dear heavenly Father, thank You for making me a carrier of divine chromosome. As I rise to the task of succeeding; bear me on the eagle’s wings in Jesus' name, Amen. “And the man increased exceedingly, and had much cattle, and maidservants, and menservants, and camels.” (KJV) Gen 30:43 Jacob was a man of great prosperity. A man of ever increasing wealth. This was a geometric dimension to riches - riches by the order of supernatural multiplication. I see God take you beyond where you’re financially to where you’ve never imagined in the next three months. Talking yourself to the top is not enough. You have to work yourself to the top. Becoming great is in working and not in wishing. Remember the LORD - don’t depart from Him. The power for true and lasting wealth comes only from Him - keep away from every diabolic means of getting wealth. Above it all, understand that wealth is supernatural as well as spiritual - engage in covenant practices such as covenant seed-sowing, covenant faith-talk, covenant great-works and the like.

title: : EXCEEDING GREA TNESS
body: : EXCEEDING GREA TNESS

title: : HE P AID FOR IT!
body: : HE P AID FOR IT! “Wherefore he saith, When he ascended up on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts unto men” (KJV) Eph 4:8 The above verse appears in Psalms 68:18 thus, “Thou hast ascended on high, thou hast led captivity captive: thou hast received gifts for men.” (KJV). This signifies that Jesus triumphantly conquered for us. This He did more than two thousand years ago when, at the Golgotha, He gave His precious life a ransom for us. He bled, died and resurrected. The power of servitude was victoriously subdued. True greatness begins with victory over sin, Rom 6:14. Besides, you're not permitted to be sick. Why? Jesus paid for it. God never had a covenant of sickness for you. Your body is the temple of the Living God. If by any means or mistake, sickness is found in your body, curse the root of that sickness right NOW. Don't forget, He led the captivity captive.
prayer: 1. Deal with every root of sin in your life 2. Pray against sickness and cover your family with the blood of Jesus 3. Deal with every form of slavery and satanic activities and release yourself into God’s plans of great achievement. [Hymn: Are You Washed in the Blood?] “Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper. even as thy soul prospereth” (KJV) 3 Jn 2 God's perfect desire for you is your complete and entire success. God is deeply concerned about every area of your life. Your life is much more important to Him than you can ever imagine or figure out. It was with this understanding John the beloved prayed that ye might prosper. There are three dimensions to John's prayer: (I) He prayed for your physical life - health for the body. (II) He prayed for your non-physical life - health for the soul. (III) He prayed for your prosperity in secular life. These three areas are so essential and crucial to the comfort of life. They are the core of life. “We're the best of friends, and I pray for good fortune in everything you do, and for your good health - that your everyday affairs prosper, as well as your soul!” (TBCL). Your fortune [great wealth and good destiny] in everything is God’s number one priority. God’s intension for you is your full life!

title: : MANAGING YOUR GREA TNESS
verse: the garden of Eden to dress it and to keep it” (KJV)
body: : MANAGING YOUR GREA TNESS “And the LORD God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to dress it and to keep it” (KJV) Gen 2:15 As we come to the end of our special study on grea tness, you've got to know that you’v e a responsibility to manage your successes. It’s one thing to be great, it’s quite another thing to remain great. God had brought the first man He created into a position of distinction and dignity. God charged him with a responsibility of dressing and keeping the garden. By divine providence, the height of distinction and dignity attained to must be kept. The Hebrew word used for ‘to keep’ is shamar denoting to hedge about, guard, protect and preserve. You’ve a responsibility to watch over your life and protect your destiny. Take care of all areas of your life. Each area of life is precious. Keep it and keep it well. Others are envying you. Safe guard your life and manage each degree of success you’ve attained in life. With your diligence and discipline, you enjoy greater degree of distinction and dignity.
prayer: Dear God, by Your enabling strength, I will protect my achievement. I receive more grace to be diligent in Jesus precious name, Amen. “Love worketh no ill to his neighbour: therefore love is the fulfilling of the law” (KJV) Rom 13: 10 True love truly loves. Love does everything but does no harm either to himself or his neighbour. Here is Jesus' frank and forthright message, “Ye have heard that it hath been said, Thou shalt love thy neighbour, and hate thine enemy. But I say unto you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you” (KJV) Matt 5:43-44. In all matter of life, Jesus' Word remains final! True love does not harm no matter the situation. Love is simply harmless – undamaging and undisruptive! True love will be proved and tested. When hurt or slighted, real biblical love still loves without wronging the wrong doer. Rom 5:5. You can't truly love and be lost. Love leads the way and keeps you in the will of God. With our Christ-like love, we can make a better world. Above it all, love yourself. And believe God loves you.
